newsitem.title: USA: Valassis to sell 13 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Valassis to sell 13 million shares.

text.p: Valassis Communications Inc said Friday it has filed a form S-3 registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 13 million shares of its common stock.
All of the shares are being sold by an affiliate of Consolidated Press Holdings Ltd, a 50 percent shareholder of Valassis, the company said.
Valassis said it will not receive any of the proceeds of the offering.

Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc and Morgan Stanley Dean Witter are joint lead managing underwriters. Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Bear, Stearns & Co will act as co-managers.
